Shyamalan organized the narrative of 
Unbreakable to parallel a comic book's traditional 
three-part story structure. After settling on the 
origin story, Shyamalan wrote the screenplay as a 
speculative screenplay with Willis already set to star in the film and Jackson in mind to portray Elijah Price. Filming began in April 2000 and was completed in July. 
Unbreakable was released on November 22, 2000. It received generally positive reviews,
[2] with praise for Shyamalan's direction, screenplay, its aesthetics, the performances, the emotional weight of the story, cinematography, and the score by 
James Newton Howard. The film has subsequently gained a strong 
cult following.

superhero genre,

superhero films. In 2011, 
Time listed it as one of the top ten superhero films of all time, ranking it number four.
[5]Quentin Tarantino also included it on his list of the top 20 films released from 1992 to 2009.
